# Redirection behaviour is pack-independent; cases are grouped by rule.

# output to a plain relative file inside the working directory
cat file.txt > out.txt
cat file.txt >> out.txt
cat file.txt>out.txt
ls -la>>out.txt
ls file2>out.txt
ls > bashrc-notes.txt
ls > cron-notes.txt
ls > sub/dir/out.txt
gh pr view 42 > out.txt
gh issue list >> out.txt
gh issue list>>out.txt

# explicit fd and combined stdout/stderr forms
ls 2>err.txt
ls &> out.txt
ls &>>out.txt
gh pr view 42 1>out.json
gh pr list &>out.txt

# /dev/null is the only absolute target
ls 2> /dev/null

# fd duplication and several redirections in a row
ls > out.txt 2>&1
ls > out.txt 2> err.txt
gh pr view 42 > out.txt 2>&1
gh pr view 42 > out.txt 2> err.txt

# redirection on a segment other than the last
sort file.txt | uniq > sorted.txt
find . -name "*.log" | grep error >> errors.txt
pwd ; ls -la > listing.txt
ls > out.txt && pwd
cat file.txt > out.txt | grep foo
ls > out.txt ; pwd
gh pr view 1 | grep open > open.txt
gh pr view 42 > out.txt | grep open
